requestRate: requests | where timestamp > ago(5m) and cloud_RoleName == 'researchhub-backend' | summarize Signal=count()/60.0 by bin(timestamp, 1m)
errorRate: requests | where timestamp > ago(5m) and cloud_RoleName == 'researchhub-backend' | summarize Total=count(), Errors=countif(toint(resultCode) >= 500) by bin(timestamp, 1m) | where Total >= __MIN_REQUESTS__ | project timestamp, Signal=100.0*Errors/Total
p95Latency: requests | where timestamp > ago(5m) and cloud_RoleName == 'researchhub-backend' | summarize Signal=percentile(todouble(duration), 95) by bin(timestamp, 1m)
connectionPressure: customMetrics | where timestamp > ago(5m) and cloud_RoleName == 'researchhub-backend' | where name in ('hikaricp_connections_active','hikaricp_connections_max') | summarize Active=maxif(value, name=='hikaricp_connections_active'), Capacity=maxif(value, name=='hikaricp_connections_max') by cloud_RoleInstance, bin(timestamp,1m) | where Capacity > 0 | project timestamp, cloud_RoleInstance, Signal=100.0*Active/Capacity
connectionWaiters: customMetrics | where timestamp > ago(5m) and cloud_RoleName == 'researchhub-backend' | where name == 'hikaricp_connections_pending' | summarize Signal=max(value) by cloud_RoleInstance, bin(timestamp,1m)
connectionTimeouts: customMetrics | where timestamp > ago(5m) and cloud_RoleName == 'researchhub-backend' | where name == 'hikaricp_connections_timeout' | summarize Signal=sum(value) by cloud_RoleInstance, bin(timestamp,1m)
processingFailures: customMetrics | where timestamp > ago(5m) and cloud_RoleName == 'researchhub-backend' | where name == 'researchhub_jobs_queue' and tostring(customDimensions.queue) == 'SOURCE_INGEST' and tostring(customDimensions.status) == 'FAILED' | summarize Signal=max(value) by bin(timestamp,1m)
sandboxFailures: customMetrics | where timestamp > ago(5m) and cloud_RoleName == 'researchhub-backend' | where name == 'researchhub_worker_failures' and tostring(customDimensions.queue) == 'ANALYSIS_EXECUTION' | summarize Signal=sum(value) by bin(timestamp,1m)
aiUnavailable: customMetrics | where timestamp > ago(5m) and cloud_RoleName == 'researchhub-backend' | where name == 'researchhub_ai_provider_unavailable' | summarize Signal=sum(value) by bin(timestamp,1m)
aiLatency: customMetrics | where timestamp > ago(5m) and cloud_RoleName == 'researchhub-backend' | where name == 'researchhub_ai_request_duration' | summarize TotalMs=sum(coalesce(valueSum,value)), Samples=sum(coalesce(valueCount,1)) by bin(timestamp,1m) | where Samples > 0 | project timestamp, Signal=TotalMs/Samples
requestsPresent: requests | where timestamp > ago(15m) and cloud_RoleName == 'researchhub-backend' | summarize Samples=count()
metricsPresent: customMetrics | where timestamp > ago(15m) and cloud_RoleName == 'researchhub-backend' | summarize Samples=count() by name
logs: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(30m) and ContainerAppName_s == 'ca-rh-backend' | extend Entry=parse_json(Log_s) | project TimeGenerated, replica=tostring(Entry.replicaId), commit=tostring(Entry.commit), requestId=tostring(Entry.requestId), event=tostring(Entry.event), status=toint(Entry.status)
